# Live Eat Learn

> A vegetarian recipe and nutrition blog by Sarah Bond offering easy, plant-based recipes with searchable indexes, meal plans, and digital cookbooks.

Live Eat Learn is a comprehensive resource for vegetarian cooking created by Sarah Bond, a nutritionist and sensory scientist. The site features hundreds of easy vegetarian recipes organized by ingredient, category, and dietary preference, along with exclusive membership content and a published cookbook.

## Key Topics

- vegetarian recipes
- plant-based cooking
- easy dinners
- high-protein
- vegan recipes
- chickpea recipes
- dump-and-bake
- seasonal recipes
- ingredient-based search
- nutrition
- Sarah Bond
- recipe collection
- dietary categories
- cooking methods

## Core Content

- [Live Eat Learn | Easy Vegetarian Recipes + Nutrition](https://www.liveeatlearn.com): Homepage for Live Eat Learn, a vegetarian recipe and nutrition blog by Sarah Bond
- [Easy Vegetarian Recipe Index | Live Eat Learn](https://www.liveeatlearn.com/recipes): Main recipe index with searchable vegetarian recipes organized by category
- [Recipes by Ingredient | Live Eat Learn](https://www.liveeatlearn.com/recipes/recipes-by-ingredient): Alphabetical directory of plant-based recipes organized by ingredient

## Products & Membership

- [Eat! 100+ Easy Vegetarian Recipes You'll Make Again and Again](https://shop.liveeatlearn.com/products/eat-100-easy-vegetarian-recipes-you-ll-make-again-and-again): Product page for Sarah Bond's vegetarian cookbook with 100+ easy recipes
